data.short_meaning: Blind to the gods, devoted to Jupiter
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Caecus' meaning 'blind'. In Roman mythology, the name Cecilius was given to those who were devoted to Jupiter, the king of the gods. The name symbolizes a deep commitment and faith towards the divine. The name Cecilius carries the meaning “Blind to the gods, devoted to Jupiter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cecilius usually hope their child will grow to embody blind to the gods, devoted to jupiter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Cecilius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blind to the gods, devoted to Jupiter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cecilius total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Cecilius was widespread throughout the early Christian communities, particularly among the Roman population. With the Romans' adoption of Christianity, names from their pagan past were Christianized, and Cecilius was no exception. Today, Cecilius is revered as a saint in the Catholic Church, and his feast day is celebrated on November 22nd.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Cecilius holds a deeper meaning as it represents spiritual blindness and the idea of faith that goes beyond the physical senses. Cecilius, as a name, encourages individuals to trust in God's wisdom and understanding, despite not fully grasping the concept with their own human comprehension. This spiritual significance was likely influenced by the Roman association with Jupiter, who was regarded as the king of the gods and the embodiment of unlimited wisdom. By embracing the name Cecilius, Christians are reminded of their faith in God and His divine guidance.
